import ctypes
import os

ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the necessary ctypes structures and function prototypes
class gsl_multiroot_fsolver(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

gsl_multiroot_fsolver_ptr = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_multiroot_fsolver)

class gsl_multiroot_fsolver_type(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("name", ctypes.c_char_p),
        ("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("alloc", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t)),
        ("set", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("iterate", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("free", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(None, ctypes.c_void_p))
    ]

gsl.gsl_multiroot_fsolver_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_multiroot_fsolver_type), ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_multiroot_fsolver_alloc.restype = gsl_multiroot_fsolver_ptr

def allocate_multiroot_solver(solver_type_ptr, size):
    """Allocates a multiroot solver using the GSL library."""
    solver = gsl.gsl_multiroot_fsolver_alloc(solver_type_ptr, size)
    if not solver:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate multiroot solver.")
    return solver
